name: Shining Mind
source:
After a near-death experience, you gain the power to enter people's minds while you sleep.
Years later, you find yourself trying to uncover the truth behind a colleague's disappearance using your powers, only to realize that you aren't the only one with such abilities.
This visual novel is an otome game that focuses on the psychology and philosophy of the various romanceable characters.

It features comedy, mystery, and horror, as well as sensitive themes that may not be suitable for all audiences.
